timeline.tweet: I am beginning to realize that there is no perfect, professional time to open up about personal vulnerabilities. And my idea of that "perfect time" just keeps changing anyways. If it exists at all, I'm not sure my anxieties would allow me to recognize it. /5

I admit - I still regularly feel this way. Even now, I fear that what I am disclosing here will lower me in the eyes of the public. After all, why choose a lawyer who openly admits mental illness, over one who appears healthy? I wrestle with this question. /8

...I was diagnosed with ADHD. In my 20's, I was diagnosed with depression and anxiety. Now, in my 30's, it's become increasingly apparent that these were actually symptoms of other, underlying problems: PTSD and/or a form of Bipolar Disorder. /3
